big_case.notes: An execution-eve capital stay application carries irreversible life-or-death stakes for the applicant, elevating it above routine procedural motions. Its broader doctrinal and national reach is narrow, however: it presented a case-specific Wiggins trial-mitigation claim dismissed at the threshold under Texas Art. 11.071, sec. 5, drew zero amicus briefs, and was summarily denied alongside certiorari without separate writing or noted dissent.
